fem_topology.coordinate_rule: x = u - tan(45 deg)*y; z up in native geometry
fem_topology.continuity: Monolithic slab-to-bent connection in drawings; single-span title. Any simple-support deck-only demonstration is an explicit analytical approximation.
analysis_assumptions_required: Concrete modulus, Poisson ratio and cracking/effective stiffness
Pile and soil stiffness if included
No beam lines or discrete bearings in the source slab topology
Exclude approach slabs/rails from default deck pressure area

assumptions: Whole-crossing exterior reconstruction of the stated proposed design, not an as-built survey or confirmation of construction completion.
Amber / needs_detail: fabrication tolerances, exact field seats, local notches and transitions, small fittings, and terrain remain incomplete.
Internal reinforcement, shear studs, embedded anchors and welds are omitted. No rendered component is a finite element or a solid-stress result.
Any later FEM must freeze its own material, stiffness, connectivity and support assumptions. Visual mesh volume is not a section-property source.
Foundations are hidden by default; foundation envelopes are design references and do not establish actual field embedment.
The source title calls the deck simple-span while the bents are explicitly integral; an FE boundary model must state its rotational idealization and may not silently invent discrete bearings.
Vertical curve uses the source 170 ft curve, +0.730%/-0.622% slopes and nominal PVI station 507+10; absolute height is shifted to a 3 m local datum.
Foundation cylinders show exterior envelopes only. Pipe wall thickness and estimated tip elevations are source values, not verified as-driven geometry.
source_page_policy: Unchanged one-based original primary PDF pages. Secondary sources have independent original PDF page numbers.
